jobs.title: SAP BRIM Developer
jobs.description:
**Experience:** 9\+ Years (Relevant Experience)  
**Job Type:** Full\-Time  
**Seniority Level:** Mid\-Senior to Senior Level

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced **SAP BRIM Developer** with strong expertise in SAP Billing and Revenue Innovation Management (BRIM) to design, develop, enhance, and support enterprise\-level billing and revenue management solutions.

The ideal candidate should have hands\-on experience across **SAP SOM, Convergent Charging (CC), Convergent Invoicing (CI), and FI\-CA**, along with strong ABAP development and SAP S/4HANA integration capabilities.

Candidates should have experience working on subscription\-based and usage\-based billing models, enterprise integrations, performance optimization, and production support.

Key Responsibilities

* Design, develop, enhance, and support SAP BRIM technical solutions across SOM, CC, CI, and FI\-CA.
* Develop custom ABAP programs, BADIs, user exits, enhancements, APIs, OData services, and workflows.
* Support subscription lifecycle management, including order capture, contract modifications, fulfillment, and provisioning.
* Develop and support charging, rating, pricing, and usage\-based billing solutions.
* Handle invoicing, billing aggregation, invoice generation, reconciliation, and financial posting processes.
* Support FI\-CA functionalities, including customer account management, payment processing, collections, dunning, and dispute management.
* Develop and maintain integrations between SAP BRIM, SAP S/4HANA, CRM/CX platforms, middleware, and third\-party systems.
* Perform unit testing, integration testing, debugging, troubleshooting, and defect resolution.
* Optimize application performance and ensure scalability for high\-volume billing and charging environments.
* Provide production support and participate in deployments, cutovers, and maintenance activities.
* Prepare technical specifications, interface documentation, and operational runbooks.
* Collaborate with SAP architects, functional consultants, integration teams, and business stakeholders.

Required Skills \& Qualifications

* 7\+ years of SAP technical development experience.
* 3\+ years of hands\-on SAP BRIM development experience.
* Strong experience in SAP BRIM components:
* Subscription Order Management (SOM)
* Convergent Charging (CC)
* Convergent Invoicing (CI)
* Contract Accounts Receivable and Payable (FI\-CA)
* Strong ABAP development expertise.
* Hands\-on experience with BADIs, User Exits, Enhancements, RFCs, APIs, and OData services.
* Good understanding of subscription\-based and usage\-based billing models.
* Experience with SAP HANA and SAP S/4HANA integrations.
* Knowledge of middleware, API integrations, and enterprise integration patterns.
* Experience in performance tuning, debugging, and production support.
* Strong analytical, communication, and problem\-solving skills.

Preferred Certifications

* SAP Certified Development Associate – ABAP.
* SAP Certified Application Associate – SAP BRIM.
* SAP HANA Certification.
* SAP S/4HANA Technical Certification.
* SAP BTP or Cloud Certifications (AWS, Azure, or GCP).

Education

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline.

Equivalent relevant professional experience may also be considered.

Ideal Candidate Profile

We are particularly interested in mid\-to\-senior\-level professionals with **9\+ years of relevant experience**, strong hands\-on SAP BRIM development capabilities, and the ability to deliver scalable enterprise billing and revenue management solutions.

**If you have strong expertise in SAP BRIM (SOM, CC, CI, FI\-CA) and ABAP development, we would love to hear from you!**

Pay: ₹100,000\.00 \- ₹150,000\.00 per month

Work Location: Remote

The candidate is responsible for translating business requirements into system solutions, managing data migration, testing, training, and post\-go\-live support, while aligning with SAP best practices and project timelines.

• Being part of Global IT team and responsible for SAP SD (Sales and Distribution) module configuration and associated developments are designed, built, tested \& deployed according to S/4 HANA best practices. • Facilitate and support workstream managers / Solution Architects \& leads right from requirement gathering, solution design with focus on Sales and Customer Service processes and integration of same with operations, finance \& product management workstreams. • Analyse business requirements related to sales quotations, sales orders management, order fulfilment, invoicing, returns and credit management processes. Internal • Configure core SD components such as sales order types, item categories, ATP, pricing procedures, delivery types, billing types and work with technical teams for WRICEF developments • Responsible for creating/maintaining functional specifications for WRICEF (Workflow, Report, Interface, Conversion, Enhancement, Forms) objects. • Perform configuration, testing, training, migration, cutover, go\-live and hyper care activities. • Support incidents or change requests for the live Business units. • Collaborate with BRIM, MM, FI, PP and EWM module consultants to support cross\-functional processes.


**SELECTION CRITERIA**

**Desirable**: • SAP S/4 HANA Certification in SAP SD. • Knowledge of new features in SAP S/4HANA like embedded analytics, user experience using Fiori, SAP cloud platform • Basic ABAP debugging or familiarity with enhancement frameworks.
